content.short: AGORA Finance issues AUSD, a fully USD-backed stablecoin designed to provide billions of people access to a stable, transparent digital dollar.
content.description: AGORA Finance is a decentralized stablecoin protocol issuing AUSD, a fully collateralized stablecoin pegged to the US dollar built on transparent blockchain infrastructure. The protocol aims to bring accessible dollar-denominated digital currency to anyone globally, with AUSD designed for broad composability across DeFi protocols on Mantle and other chains. AGORA has received both official recognition and EcoFund backing from the Mantle Network, positioning AUSD as a key stablecoin primitive in the ecosystem.
content.meta: AGORA Finance issues AUSD, a USD-backed stablecoin for a secure and inclusive DeFi ecosystem on Mantle. Discover AGORA on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
